metadata.method: RGB pigment masks; local luminance seam tracing; simplified connected contours with interior holes.
metadata.interpretation: Interpretive relief derived from scan colors and boundaries. The image provides no recovered true depth; extrusion heights are artistic choices.
metadata.coordinates: u and v in [0,1], origin top-left; x = (u - 0.5) * 24; z = (v - 0.5) * 22.36; y points up.
metadata.areaUnits: source pixels squared, minus retained holes
metadata.heightField: 128 by 120, row-major, y top-down; subdued normalized height, no normalization to tallest point.

legend.red: Scanned red pigment: EXIT lettering and border, torn diagonal caution stripes.
legend.ink: Scanned black lettering: the clipped CAUTION and TWEEN CAR rows, including glyph counters.
legend.paper: Sign substrates: contour of the EXIT border and traced caution sheet top seam; sides are source crop boundaries.
